fact: ITWeb Africa reported on 2026-06-11 that Malawi's Ministry of ICT has proposed a Government Data Sharing Regulation, a binding rule routing all government data exchange through the National Data Centre with a common digital standard so government systems can communicate.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that the Malawi Enterprise Architecture and Interoperability Framework (MEAIF) is in draft or planned, with 2026 as its year; the line gives no statement date, so the 2025 round year is used.
